lineage.approach: V2 builds on prior creative arrangement, replaces fragile gzip import route and completes previously missing scene scope

Two illuminated pumps with original graphic text

Licensed CesiumMan GLB loaded at runtime, person trajectory
Rain particles, splash rings, lightning, wet asphalt light streaks
Cinematic 36-second track and touch-friendly free orbit
Explicit 2D error panel instead of V1 generic load error
Visible actor asset failure warning and deterministic animation pause
